dict.string: The camera is used to detect body joints during your practice session. Only joint coordinates are sent to your Mac; video is not recorded or transmitted.
The microphone is used for on-device transcription and speech/silence detection during practice. Audio is not stored or transmitted.
Speech is transcribed on this iPhone to measure speaking rate, pauses and filler words. Recognition runs on device only.
Coach Capture sends joint and speech measurements to the coaching service on your Mac over your local network.
Reads heart-rate samples from a workout you start on Apple Watch and mirror to this iPhone, to show them next to your practice session.
